source-integrity.freshness: Q2 2026 primary results dated 2026-08-03, September 2026 product evidence, and market valuation observed 2026-09-25
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: issuer and SEC-origin duplicates are treated as single factual origins where applicable
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: current valuation uses independent market data; issuer technical claims are not treated as independent corroboration

company-underwriting.operatingFinancialTrajectory: Q2 2026 revenue was $1.604b, up 9% YoY; GAAP gross margin was 38.4%, GAAP operating margin 16.1%, and free cash flow $425.4m, approximately quadrupling YoY.
company-underwriting.contractsBacklogCustomersSuppliers: AI data center was described as the fastest-growing business with 2026 revenue expected to more than double; platform wins and NVIDIA MGX participation support demand, while semiconductor qualification, utilization and inventory remain conversion constraints.
company-underwriting.balanceSheetRunwayDebtDilution: Strong Q2 free cash flow supports funding capacity; $332m of Q2 repurchases brought YTD shareholder returns to about 105% of free cash flow. Current market data shows about $30.05b market cap and $30.90b enterprise value.
company-underwriting.managementGovernanceCapitalAllocation: Management is allocating toward power, sensing and connected compute, including planned Synaptics acquisition; buybacks and improving operating leverage are constructive while acquisition and fab capital intensity require discipline.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Gross-margin improvement and differentiated power products support moderate value capture; cyclical semiconductor competition and utilization constrain stronger structural pricing conclusions.

thesisQuality.basis: Power and sensing address durable electrification needs with improving Q2 execution, while EPP commercial-scale adoption and acquisition outcomes remain unproven.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 revenue rose 9% YoY, GAAP operating margin reached 16.1%, and free cash flow of $425.4m quadrupled YoY, though TTM revenue remains below prior-cycle levels.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: At $77.20, about $30.05b market cap and 19.86x forward P/E, valuation is balanced-to-attractive if the earnings recovery persists, but not distressed.

catalystScore.basis: AI data-center revenue growth, EPP/GaNEXUS ramps, the next earnings event and planned Synaptics transaction provide several identifiable catalysts with execution uncertainty.

governancePower.basis: Improving operating leverage, substantial repurchases and portfolio focus support capital-allocation credibility; planned acquisition and manufacturing intensity prevent stronger treatment.

alignment2036.basis: Power conversion and sensing serve AI infrastructure, automotive electrification, robotics and industrial energy efficiency across multiple long-duration needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Core power and sensing capabilities span AI data centers, automotive and industrial infrastructure, providing multiple independent demand engines.

bottleneckControl.basis: Power-density and thermal constraints are real system bottlenecks and EPP targets them directly, but commercial-scale proof and unique control are not yet established.

scenarioRobustness.basis: AI infrastructure, automotive and industrial electrification diversify demand, though semiconductor cycles and technology shifts remain material.

substitutionResilience.basis: Qualification and differentiated power architectures create friction, while competing silicon, SiC, GaN and packaging solutions remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Owned manufacturing provides control but inventory, fab utilization, yield and semiconductor supply dependencies remain meaningful.

pricingPower.basis: 38.4% GAAP gross margin and improving operating leverage support moderate value capture, but cyclical competition and utilization limit evidence for durable scarcity rent.

riskEvidence.basis: Risks include cyclical demand, capital intensity/utilization, EPP adoption and yield uncertainty, competing architectures and acquisition execution.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Operating results and identity are primary-source supported and valuation is independently current; confidence is reduced for EPP commercial economics and future acquisition outcomes.

scoreRecord.thesis: onsemi combines improving cash generation with durable power-conversion exposure across AI, automotive and industrial markets, while cyclicality, capital intensity and unproven new-platform economics cap conviction.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: AI/power expectations outrun actual qualification, utilization and economic returns while competing architectures or a semiconductor downturn compress margins.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Estimated November 2, 2026 earnings and evidence of AI data-center, EPP/GaNEXUS customer ramps and planned Synaptics transaction progress.

scoreBreakdown.note: Methodology 1.0 weighted component score; risk and confidence remain separately preserved.
